title: I will try to learn it, said Stephen
html_source: Stephen is clearly being sarcastic. The dean is trying to point out to Stephen that useful things like math, science, history, Latin, basically all the subjects he’s neglecting have a certain ‘art’ to it. By playing on the description of art the dean is trying to get Stephen to connect artistry, or the liberal arts, to the other subjects.

anchor.text: I will try to learn it, said Stephen

 —One moment now, Mr Dedalus, and you will see. There is an art in lighting a fire. We have the liberal arts and we have the useful arts. This is one of the useful arts.
